name: AnyScribe
tagline: Search and read your AnyScribe transcripts, and send links to your iPhone to transcribe.
description: Official remote MCP server for AnyScribe, an iPhone and iPad transcription app. Search and read your transcripts of videos, podcasts, lectures and voice memos, with their summaries, translations and highlights; list transcriptions, folders and highlights; and send YouTube, TikTok or Instagram links to your iPhone to transcribe and follow their progress. Library tools are read-only. Sign in with your Apple ID through OAuth; no API key needed.
